lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-section, becoming narrower toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most stripes on the flank are fragmented into dashed segments and discrete circular dots rather than continuous lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 14-16 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots on the upper hind leg are aligned horizontally, forming a semi-linear geometric pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron marking between the eyes and two distinct white patches on the lower neck and throat area.
